description.zh: 根据特定的消费者授权规则ID过滤接口列表，响应中的接口列表仅包含已授权的接口。
description.en: The consumer authorization rule ID used to filter the API operation list. The response includes only authorized API operations.
Specifies whether to filter by authentication enablement status.
Specifies whether the request is for a deployment scenario.
The gateway ID used to filter results.
The ID of the target HTTP API.
Lists API operations by HTTP method.
Searches for API operations by exact name match.

description.zh: 按接口名称前缀搜索接口。
description.en: Searches for API operations by name prefix.

description.zh: 分页页码，从1开始，不填默认1。
description.en: The page number to return. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1.

description.zh: 分页大小，有效范围[1, 100]，不填默认10。
description.en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10.

description.zh: 按路径前缀匹配搜索接口。
description.en: Searches for API operations by path prefix match.

description.zh: 响应中每个接口信息携带指定环境ID下的指定消费者的授权规则列表。需要额外指定withConsumerInfoById字段。
description.en: The environment ID. When specified, the response includes the authorization rule list of the specified consumer under the specified environment for each API operation. You must also specify the withConsumerInfoById parameter.

description.zh: 响应中每个接口信息携带指定环境ID下的指定消费者的授权规则列表。需要额外指定withConsumerInEnvironmentId字段。
description.en: The consumer ID. When specified, the response includes the authorization rule list of the specified consumer under the specified environment for each API operation. You must also specify the withConsumerInEnvironmentId parameter.

description.zh: 插件ID，根据此插件ID获取插件发布信息。
description.en: The plug-in ID used to retrieve plug-in publishing information.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun apig list-http-api-operations --http-api-id api-xxx --biz-method GET --path-like /v1 --name-like GetUser --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --name getUserInfo --with-consumer-in-environment-id env-xxx --with-consumer-info-by-id cs-xxx --consumer-authorization-rule-id cas-xxx --with-plugin-attachment-by-plugin-id pl-xxx --for-deploy true --gateway-id gw-001 --enable-auth true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun apig GET /v1/http-apis/api-xxx/operations --region cn-hangzhou --pageNumber 1 --method GET --enableAuth true --withPluginAttachmentByPluginId 'pl-xxx' --withConsumerInEnvironmentId 'env-xxx' --pageSize 10 --forDeploy true --pathLike '/v1' --nameLike GetUser --name getUserInfo --consumerAuthorizationRuleId 'cas-xxx' --gatewayId 'gw-001' --withConsumerInfoById 'cs-xxx' --header "Content-Type=application/json"
